name: Donchian Channel Breakout (Turtle Rules)
source: Classic — Turtle Trading Rules (Richard Dennis / William Eckhardt), simplified single-unit System 1
notes: Hand-authored baseline, not scraped. N-bar breakout trend-following: enter long on a new entryLen-bar high, short on a new entryLen-bar low; exit on the opposite (shorter) exitLen-bar extreme — the real Turtle system's faster exit channel, not just a stop-and-reverse.
